               opp_score = sum(r for r, c in opp_pieces) * 10
           material = (len(my_pieces) - len(opp_pieces)) * 100
           return my_score - opp_score + material
       
       # Get my legal moves
       my_moves, win = generate_moves(me_set, opp_set, direction, my_goal)
       if win:
           return my_moves[0]
       if not my_moves:
           # No legal moves (shouldn't happen in valid game state)
           return list(me_set)[0], list(me_set)[0]  # Invalid, but prevents crash
       
       best_move = my_moves[0]
       best_score = -float('inf')
       
       # Search 2 ply
       for move in my_moves:
           # Make my move
           r1, c1 = move[0]
           r2, c2 = move[1]
           new_me = set(me_set)
           new_me.remove((r1, c1))
           new_me.add((r2, c2))
           new_opp = set(opp_set)
           was_capture = (r2, c2) in new_opp
           if was_capture:
               new_opp.remove((r2, c2))
           
           if r2 == my_goal:
               return move  # Winning move
           
           # Get opponent's response
           opp_goal = 0 if color == 'w' else 7
           opp_dir = -direction
           opp_moves, opp_win = generate_moves(new_opp, new_me, opp_dir, opp_goal)
           
           if opp_win:
               # Opponent can win, this move is bad unless we have no choice
               score = -5000
           elif not opp_moves:
               # Stalemate for opponent? Actually in Breakthrough, no legal moves might mean loss?
               # But usually if opponent has no pieces, we won, caught above.
               score = 5000
           else:
               # Evaluate worst case (best move for opponent)
               worst_score = float('inf')
               for opp_move in opp_moves:
                   or1, oc1 = opp_move[0]
                   or2, oc2 = opp_move[1]
                   
                   # Apply opponent move
                   final_opp = set(new_opp)
                   final_opp.remove((or1, oc1))
                   final_opp.add((or2, oc2))
                   final_me = set(new_me)
                   if (or2, oc2) in final_me:
                       final_me.remove((or2, oc2))
                   
                   if or2 == opp_goal:
                       score = -5000  # I lose
                   else:
                       score = evaluate(final_me, final_opp)
                   
                   if score < worst_score:
                       worst_score = score
                       # Early exit if very bad?
                       if worst_score < -4000:
                           break
               
               score = worst_score
           
           # Bonus for capture
           if was_capture:
               score += 50
           
           if score > best_score:
               best_score = score
               best_move = move
           
           if time.time() - start > 0.9:
               break
       
       return best_move
